meta.title: 拯救郁金香拉花：推得太小变形怎么办
meta.title_en: Fix Your Tulip Latte Art: Too Small or Distorted?
meta.topic: 咖啡拉花 · 郁金香教学

scenes.title_cn: 开场：郁金香推得小又变形
scenes.context: 新手推郁金香最常见的失败：图案非常小，或者变形，没有完整半圆形。UP 主先确认图案在杯内的位置，再讲如何推。
sentences: 很多新手在推郁金香的时候，图案都非常小，要不然就是变形的。
Beginners often pour tulips that come out tiny — or just distorted.
pour a tulip（推郁金香/拉花）
没有非常完整的那种半圆形。
There's no clean, full half-circle shape at all.
half-circle（半圆形）
首先我们要确认一下郁金香它在杯子里面的位置。
First, let's figure out where the tulip should sit inside the cup.
where it sits（位置/落点）
paraphrase: The design comes out all wonky.
Let's nail down the placement first.
scenes.speak: Beginners often pour tulips that come out tiny — or just distorted. There's no clean, full half-circle shape at all. First, let's figure out where the tulip should sit inside the cup.

scenes.title_cn: 橡皮筋中轴线：圈定推花范围
scenes.title_en: The Rubber-Band Centerline: Define the Pour Zone
scenes.context: 在杯身横一条橡皮筋作为中轴线；推奶泡时从橡皮筋后一点点位置推向中轴线，收勾时同样不越过橡皮筋。
sentences: 我会在杯子上先横一条橡皮筋，作为它的中轴线。
I'll first stretch a rubber band across the cup as its centerline.
centerline（中轴线）
你的点应该是从橡皮筋后一点点的位置推向它，千万不要超过橡皮筋。
Start your pour just behind the band and push toward the line — never go past it.
just behind（后一点点）
勾的时候也要注意，不要超过橡皮筋。
When you hook upward, mind the line again — don't cross it.
hook upward（向上勾）
paraphrase: Finish the pull without dragging past the line.
scenes.speak: I'll first stretch a rubber band across the cup as its centerline. Start your pour just behind the band and push toward the line — never go past it. When you hook upward, mind the line again — don't cross it.

scenes.title_cn: 换大缸宽嘴：让奶泡大胆释放
scenes.title_en: Bigger Pitcher, Wider Spout: Let the Milk Flow
scenes.context: 解决图案太小的核心工具调整：用更大的拉花缸和更宽的缸嘴，帮助奶泡大胆释放，郁金香才能推得好看。
sentences: 我们要用一个更大的拉花缸。
We should switch to a bigger latte-art pitcher.
latte-art pitcher（拉花缸）
而且这个嘴它会更宽，它可以帮助你把奶泡大胆地释放出来。
Its spout is wider, too — it lets you release the milk boldly.
spout（缸嘴）
这样你的郁金香就可以推得非常的好看。
That way your tulip pours beautifully.
pour beautifully（推得好看）
paraphrase: Let the milk flow out freely instead of in a trickle.
You get a full, generous tulip instead of a stubby one.
scenes.speak: We should switch to a bigger latte-art pitcher. Its spout is wider, too — it lets you release the milk boldly. That way your tulip pours beautifully.

scenes.title_cn: 原理与成品：倾斜角度 × 流量
scenes.title_en: Why It Works: Tilt Angle × Flow Rate
scenes.context: 大奶缸增加向下的倾斜角度，宽嘴帮助释放流量；按这套标准完整演示，郁金香就能做得更好看。
sentences: 更大的奶缸可以增加它向下的倾斜角度。
A bigger pitcher lets you tilt it down more steeply.
tilt angle（倾斜角度）
用更宽的嘴可以帮助我们把流量释放出来。
A wider spout helps us release more flow.
flow rate（流量）
按照这个标准来做，你的郁金香就可以做得更加的好看。
Follow this standard and your tulip will look even better.
follow this standard（按这个标准）
paraphrase: You can angle it down further.
The milk pours out with more ease.
scenes.speak: A bigger pitcher lets you tilt it down more steeply. A wider spout helps us release more flow. Follow this standard and your tulip will look even better.

practice.q: 「郁金香推得太小、变形」英文怎么说？
practice.a: The tulip comes out tiny — or just distorted.

practice.q: 「从橡皮筋后一点点推向中轴线」怎么表达？
practice.a: Start just behind the band and push toward the centerline.

practice.q: 「用更宽的缸嘴释放流量」怎么说？
practice.a: A wider spout helps release more flow.

practice.q: 「按这个标准做，拉花更好看」怎么讲？
practice.a: Follow this standard and your latte art will look even better.

pitfalls: Pour hard to force a bigger tulip.
Switch to a bigger pitcher with a wider spout.
Force doesn't fix flow — the spout size controls how much milk releases.
Freehand the position without a reference.
Mark a centerline on the cup, like a rubber band.
A visible line turns vague placement into a repeatable rule.
Hook upward past the centerline for a longer petal.
Hook upward and stop at the line.
Crossing the line breaks the leaf's edge and distorts the shape.
Tilt the pitcher as much as possible.
Tilt enough to control direction and keep flow steady.
Over-tilting floods the surface and washes out the pattern.
shifts: 图案小或变形，靠手感硬试
